narrative.overview:
Hoisted looks like a developer's control panel drawn in pixels: solid blocks of flat colour, ink-navy outlines, and hard shadows that sit a few pixels off every surface as if the interface were printed rather than rendered. The page itself is a pale dot-grid sheet; content lives on white blocks fenced by a 2px navy edge. Nothing glows, nothing blurs, nothing fades into a gradient — depth comes from offset, and emphasis comes from a block of colour.

The system is neo-brutalist on purpose, but it is a working console, not a poster. Learners, instructors and admins are in tasks (pick a course, finish a lesson, reconcile payouts), so density, scanability and familiar affordances win over expression. The personality lives in a few loud, repeatable decisions: the pixel headline face, the yellow "pop" button that sinks into its shadow when pressed, the navy console sidebar, and course thumbnails as flat swatches with a monospace glyph. Everything else stays disciplined.

Light is the default theme; dark keeps the same structure on a deep navy sheet with periwinkle edges and black shadows.
keyCharacteristics: 2px ink edges around every content block; hairlines only inside blocks.
Hard offset shadows with zero blur (2–8px), coloured by the theme's shadow token.
Flat, saturated colour: navy, signal blue, pixel yellow, flare orange, status green/red.
Pixel face (Handjet) for word headings only; Space Grotesk for reading; JetBrains Mono for anything a machine prints.
Near-square corners (2–6px). Circles survive only as dots, radios and progress.
Pale dot-grid page background in both themes.

rules.name: The Pop Is the Action Rule
rules.body: Pixel Yellow marks what to do; Signal Blue marks where you are. One yellow primary button per view; a selected state is blue, never a second yellow CTA.

rules.name: The Status Is Not Brand Rule
rules.body: Green, red and amber appear only when they report a state (paid, failed, passed, locked). Course levels, categories and rankings never borrow them.

rules.name: The Status Ink Rule
rules.body: Text on a solid status fill uses `success-ink` / `danger-ink` (white in light mode, navy in dark mode), because the night status colours are too bright for white text.

rules.name: The Token-Not-Hex Rule
rules.body: Themed surfaces use the semantic tokens (`bg`, `bg-1…3`, `ink`, `ink-2…3`, `edge`, `line`, `accent`, `pop`, `success`, `danger`). Raw hex is allowed only in the fixed-colour zones that look the same in both themes: the console sidebar, code windows and terminals, and course thumbnail swatches.

rules.name: The Pixel Words Rule
rules.body: Handjet sets words only: headings and the logotype. Never numbers — its dotted zero reads as an 8 ("0%" became "8%", "399.000đ" became "399.888đ") — and never code glyphs, where "()" reads as "0".

rules.name: The Machine Truth Rule
rules.body: If a computer would print it (a price, a count, an ID, a path, code, a timestamp, a course glyph), set it in JetBrains Mono with tabular numerals.

rules.name: The Hard Shadow Rule
rules.body: Shadows have an offset and no blur. No glows, no soft ambient shadows, no `backdrop-filter`, no glass.

rules.name: The Press Rule
rules.body: A pressable block sinks toward its shadow: 1px on hover, fully onto it (shadow gone) on press, in 100ms.

dos: Do fence every content block with the 2px `edge` and give it a hard shadow from the scale (2–8px, zero blur).
Do use Pixel Yellow for the one primary action per view and Signal Blue for location and selection.
Do set numbers, prices, IDs, code and course glyphs in JetBrains Mono with tabular numerals.
Do let cards fill their grid cell and pin their last row (price, CTA) to the bottom so a row of cards lines up.
Do keep anything on screen at first paint visible before animation starts; reveal-on-scroll is only for content below the fold.
Do show a number only when it is real and non-zero; hide the stat, category or testimonial block instead of printing "0" or a one-word review.
Do keep text on status fills on `success-ink` / `danger-ink`, and pick navy or white on admin-chosen colours by luminance.
donts: Don't set numbers or code glyphs in Handjet.
Don't use gradients, glows, blur, glass or soft shadows anywhere.
Don't use pill shapes or circles for buttons, chips, avatars or tiles.
Don't colour levels, categories or rankings with status green, red or amber, or give each list row its own decorative colour.
Don't put white text on Flare Orange or on the night status colours.
Don't hardcode hex on themed surfaces; only the console sidebar, code windows and course swatches are fixed-colour.
Don't use emoji or unicode glyphs as icons in new UI.
